desc: Parse `N`, `S`, and `T`, and verify that each character of `S` has a unique mapped target in `T`.
Count non-identity source-to-target mappings and record which letters appear in `S`.
Detect directed cycles among the non-identity mappings, counting one additional operation per cycle.
Check whether at least one lowercase letter is absent from `S`; reject any cyclic case if no such temporary letter exists.
Implement the algorithm in Python with linear-time processing and print the minimum operation count or `-1`.
